schema_event_storage_impacts.note: The dry run must be an event-free local expansion: no dispatch event, no queue entry, no usage attribution. The only optional artifact is a clipboard receipt. Any implementation that routes the preview through the agent pipeline violates the demonstrated contract.

stopping/starting/done phases are ObservableWork projections; the restarted event must record reattachment to open documents, and the restart cap consumes from a per-hour budget that diagnostics can show.

Discovery results are cached with lastDiscovery + freshness; a reconnect or rediscover emits a discovery event, and a refused rediscover (disconnected) emits only a receipt. The stale cache stays readable — never cleared by failure.

Remap stores the original binding for reset; the conflict check is evaluated against the full map including plugin bindings, and an applied resolution suspends (never silently deletes) the losing binding.

schema_event_storage_impacts.impact: Demo op events aligned to the ObservableWork contract: progressKind (determinate|indeterminate), progress source (measured|derived|unknown), completed/total emitted only when a real denominator exists (bare percentages are stripped at the emitter), waitReason from the register's waiting_* vocabulary where applicable (e.g. waiting_resource on rate-limited test sends, waiting_for_idle surfaced through installation update states). Production schema should adopt the full state grammar: accepted..recovery_required.

slint_port_impacts.note: writing-mode: vertical-rl + rotate(180deg) maps to rotated Text elements inside TouchAreas in a fixed-width VerticalLayout; the depth counter is a plain rotated Text. No CSS writing modes are assumed by the semantics.

Full and half sheets map to a stack of PopupWindow-like layers or a states-driven component stack: x/scale/opacity animations on push/pop, inert lower layers, one pre-composited translucency at most on the top glass sheet. Reduced motion collapses to instant state swaps with identical end states.
The capture area maps to a FocusScope consuming key events while armed; Escape exits capture. Combo formatting is plain string assembly, portable as-is.

The testing matrix maps to a GridLayout of ComboBoxes inside the sheet's single ScrollView; the web version's bounded horizontal scroller becomes a minimum-width grid. No nested unbounded scroll views anywhere in the concept.

The live preview is a fixed sample buffer rendered with the profile's font/colors/cursor; in Slint the real terminal component renders the same sample buffer, and the ANSI strip is sixteen Rectangles.

unresolved_questions.q: The shared first-run scenario mutation empties mcp and downgrades lsp but leaves skills/plugins/tools populated; this concept renders those three as honest empties under data().firstRun per the packet's coverage expectation. Should the shared mutation own that emptying instead of the concept renderer?

The shared reconnect trigger resolves unknown refs to the first provider, so an MCP reconnect also briefly flips the Claude provider through refreshing-ready. Harmless in baseline but visible; should the trigger registry grow an mcp-reconnect entry, or should reconnect ignore unmatched refs?

Terminal profile edits mutate the live store but no terminal-profile trigger exists in the shared registry; cmd.terminal.profile.update is registered as a provisional candidate. Should profile mutation get a staged op (apply + live-preview refresh) for parity with other managers?
Shortcut conflict data models a single conflict; the resolution flow rewrites its prose resolution field. The plan should decide whether resolutions are events (auditable) or just map state.
The census figure for the settings inventory varies 817-826 across artifacts; rows referenced here are counted against none of them until the audit fixes one number.
